'2025-01-01'), base AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01') SELECT cur.revenue AS current_year_revenue, base.revenue AS base_year_revenue, CASE WHEN base.revenue IS NULL OR base.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (cur.revenue - base.revenue) / base.revenue END AS yoy_growth_rate FROM cur CROSS JOIN base;","business_basis":["confirmed_business_rules.metrics[sales_revenue]: 发票粒度销售额 = SUM(invoice.total)","controller.final_intent.time_scope.current = [2024-01-01, 2025-01-01)，comparison = year_over_year，base 由同比推导 = [2023-01-01, 2024-01-01)","confirmed_business_rules.general.date_field = invoice.invoice_date；期间左闭右开；零分母返回 NULL"],"issues":["初始输入缺 time_scope.current，按 total_plan growth 规则应为 L2 澄清；此处仅按已给出的允许补充 2024 年与 2023 年同比写 SQL，不重新选择年份。","该最终意图为同期销售额的同比增长；SQL 同时返回两期金额与增长率，所有只读聚合均来自已确认口径。"]},{"id":"sp03-07","gold_sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(total) IS NULL OR SUM(total) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE billing_country = 'USA') / SUM(total) END AS usa_billing_share FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01';","business_basis":["confirmed_business_rules.general.region: invoice.billing_country 为发票账单地址国，原题明写账单国故绑定 billing_country，不与 customer.country 合并","controller.final_intent: 分子为 2024 年 billing_country='USA' 的 SUM(invoice.total)，分母为 2024 年全球 SUM(invoice.total)","confirmed_business_rules.metrics[sales_revenue]: 发票粒度 SUM(invoice.total)","期间左闭右开；空分母/零分母返回 NULL"],"issues":["初始缺 denominator 属 ratio 类 L2，已按允许补充取 2024 年全球总销售额；未使用 customer.country。"]},{"id":"sp03-21","gold_sql":"WITH cur AS (SELECT SUM(i.total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON JOIN public.customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Germany' AND i.invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01') SELECT cur.revenue AS current_year_revenue, base.revenue AS base_year_revenue, CASE WHEN base.revenue IS NULL OR base.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (cur.revenue - base.revenue) / base.revenue END AS yoy_growth_rate FROM cur CROSS JOIN base;","business_basis":["controller.final_intent.region = {column: customer.country, value: Germany}，即客户居住地口径，不是账单国","controller.final_intent.time_scope: current=[2024-01-01, 2025-01-01)，base=[2023-01-01, 2024-01-01)，comparison=year_over_year","confirmed_business_rules.metrics[sales_revenue]: 发票粒度 SUM(invoice.total)；日期字段 invoice.invoice_date；期间左闭右开；零分母 1;","business_basis":["controller.final_intent.rank_object = customer, object_key = customer_id, metric = sales_revenue, metric_expression = SUM(invoice.total), period = [2023-01-01, 2024-01-01), rank_object，按规则应先澄清；此处仅按允许补充对象为客户写 SQL。","题目不允许输出客户联系人字段或值，故仅返回 customer_id 与金额。"]}]}
